evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: Real-time payment fraud detection is a non-stationary streaming prediction problem: adversaries adapt before supervised labels mature, and localized burst attacks can cause losses before retraining.

evidence.label: 描述评分指标或评测协议
evidence.excerpt: On a production payment-fraud benchmark, SR-Fraud improves all detection metrics over its frozen decision agent, obtains higher point estimates than static and periodically retrained CatBoost, and detects an emerging fraud burst.
